body:
Part of #140, CB-14a (br_table). This PR is stacked on #929.

The legacy rule-1140 / `br_table_impl` proofs now hold under `Stock.sem ctx`.

- `StockTableSelection`:
  - `table_selected`: the terminator slot `tableData x` selects `rule_lower_3277`. Every earlier rule has another root format.
  - `table_named_calls`: the four calls (669 in 243, 556, 670) and `calls.source = .value x`.
  - `table_named_code` (i32 index, at most 4096 labels): the exact emission `tableCode d ts r N = [emitIsland, subs wzr, r, #n, jtSequence d ts r (vreg N) (vreg N+1)]`, with `nextVreg = N+2`.
- `StockTableValues`:
  - `table_named_values`: from a held frame, the resolved code stops at the `jtSequence` on `.goto (tableTarget bits.toNat ts.length)` (= `branchIdx`). The stop register file is ρ, and the world is `SameWorldNF`.
  - `table_named_bounds` and `table_fixed_allocation`. The only definitions are in `[N, N+2)`.
- `StockTableCore`:
  - `stock_lower_table_core`: the retained core of a real `br_table` block is exactly `tableCode d ts r input.nextVreg`.
  - `CoreOrigin.table_values` and `LastTableExecution.guarded`.
- Witness: the real `isa/aarch64/jumptable.clif %f`. It parses to the literal, its block 0 code is `args` + `tableCode 4 [3,2,1] v192 204` (matching the filetest VCode), and it discharges every premise on the real slot and core. One marked `native_decide` is used.

Limits: the index must be i32 (i64 would need the upper bits to be zero; i8/i16 go through an extend), and the table must have fewer than 4096 targets (imm12 rule 5450).

New files only, unwired. Gates: the build passes (472/472), and the audit `scripts/audit/table-term.lean` passes (29/29).

Next: CB-14b, `TableBodySpec` and the carry successors indexed by `branchIdx`. Then CB-14c, the classes.
